segments.label: PAPER
segments.headline: A robot brain trained fast on one chip

beats.narration: Teaching a robot to move like us usually takes lots of computers, running for days. So can it be done on a single chip?
A UC Berkeley team built one robot brain that copies almost any human movement, even flips.
After just three hours on a single chip, it beat a top rival trained for days on a huge bank of chips.

items.label: on a single chip · beat a rival trained for days on many

beats.narration: And it worked on a real humanoid robot, acrobatic moves included.

beats.narration: The authors' verdict: computing power is no longer the bottleneck.
